measures: the integration wrapper's marshalling ONLY. After integration the Fortran body IS the translation, so no harness against this build can compare arithmetic; both sides run the same code, and a failure means the wrapper corrupted an argument or an output on the way through. The arithmetic is covered by the pre-integration harness, the kernel and the gate.
